title: Systems Neuroscience, B.S. (College of Health and Human Development)
notes: University Park, no formal tracks. Major code NROSCI avoids colliding with the pre-existing NEURO major (Eberly Science's Neurobiology) built earlier this session. Real recurring bug found and fixed at the catalog level: this major's own entrance math course is 'MATH 140B' (Calculus and Biology I), but CHEM 110's concurrent requirement, PHYS 250's prereq, and STAT 184's concurrent requirement all failed to recognize it as equivalent to MATH 140/110/22 -- added MATH 140B as an accepted alternate to all three in chem_catalog.json/phys_catalog.json/stat_catalog.json. This also required moving MATH 140B before CHEM 110 in the Semester 1 item list, since concurrent checks only see courses already picked earlier in the same scan pass. Second real bug: 'BBH 470'/'BIOL 470' both strictly require literal 'BIOL 469' as a prereq, not the cross-listed 'BBH 469' (identical course, different department code) -- reordered the Semester 5 item to list BIOL 469 first so the literal code downstream courses expect actually gets completed. Explicitly scheduled ENGL 15 (Semester 1) and CAS 100A (Semester 2) rather than generic GWS slots, since ENGL 202C later needs ENGL 15/30H specifically. 'Additional Neuroscience elective' (12 credits, 4 items, from 15 department-approved options), 'Basic Science elective' (9 credits, 3 items, from 30+ options), and generic 'University-Wide Offerings'/GEN ED pools are modeled generically, same convention as CMPSC's own open pools. Post-parens-fix re-scrape revealed CHEM 110's real prereq is MATH 22 (a placement threshold below Calc I that a MATH-140-track student has already tested past, but the bulletin's prereq text never says so explicitly), and MATH 22 has its own real chain (MATH 22 needs MATH 21, which needs MATH 4, which needs MATH 3) -- none of MATH 3/4/21/22 were in the plan, permanently blocking CHEM 110/CHEM 202, and separately STAT 200/STAT 184 both need MATH 21 directly. Added MATH 3 (Semester 1), MATH 4 (Semester 2), MATH 21 (Semester 3), and MATH 22 (Semester 4) explicitly, matching the fix used for NEURO's identical CHEM 110 gap. Two more real, unrelated gaps found in the same pass: BBH 368 and BBH 451 both require BBH 101 (Intro to Biobehavioral Health), and BBH 451 separately requires PSYCH 100 -- neither was anywhere in the plan. Added BBH 101 (Semester 1) and PSYCH 100 (Semester 2), both real, no-prereq courses. Side effect of the added Semester 2 load: with MATH 4 and PSYCH 100 both competing for Semester 2's credit budget, the Semester 3 item 'BIOL 110H (or 114+115)' started falling through to its 3cr alternate BIOL 114 instead of the 4cr BIOL 110H whenever the term was 1cr short of room -- which silently broke BIOL 230M's prereq (BIOL 230M's real prereq_groups only accept literal BIOL 110/110H, not BIOL 114, a genuinely different lecture-only course). Raised max_credits_per_semester from 19 to 20 (Semester 2 was landing exactly at the old 19cr cap) so BIOL 110H reliably wins that pick again, restoring BIOL 230M -> BIOL 469 -> BBH 470/BIOL 470's chain. Handbook verification pass: no separate department handbook beyond the bulletin, but the live bulletin (bulletins.psu.edu, 2026-27 edition) itself publishes the exact, real 'Additional neuroscience courses' (15 options, footnote 2) and 'Basic Science' (footnote 1, 38+ options) lists this plan's own notes already correctly anticipated the SIZE of ('15 department-approved options' and '30+ options', both confirmed exact matches against the live bulletin) -- wired all 4 'Additional Neuroscience Elective' slots and all 3 'Basic Science Elective' slots to these real lists, previously fully generic unfillable placeholders. Also confirmed the live bulletin's separate 'Organic chemistry: Select 3 credits from CHEM 202 or CHEM 210' requirement is already correctly modeled as this plan's explicit Semester 4 CHEM 202/210 item. The bulletin's own 'Requirements for the Major' summary table states 'Select 9 credits of University Wide Offerings' but its own concrete Suggested Academic Plan only ever schedules University Wide Offerings twice (6 credits total, matching this plan's own 2 slots) -- a real internal inconsistency in the bulletin between its summary table and its own suggested plan; followed the concrete suggested plan (and this plan's existing structure) rather than the summary table's total. BIOL 246W (on the real Basic Science list) has no matching entry in this app's own biol_catalog.json (a scraping gap) -- left in as an unchecked fallback option. Wiring the two elective pools to real courses exposed a real, pre-existing latent scheduling bug: the Semester 2 'BBH 203 (or PSYCH 260)' item was defaulting to BBH 203, but BBH 468's own prereq only recognizes literal 'BBH 469 or PSYCH 260' -- and BIOL 469 (not BBH 469) is the alternative this plan already deliberately guarantees gets picked for BBH 470/BIOL 470's sake (see the earlier note above), leaving PSYCH 260 as the only remaining real path to satisfy BBH 468's prereq. Reordered that item to list PSYCH 260 first, which permanently fixes it regardless of which other electives happen to get picked -- previously this was fragile 'accidentally worked' behavior riding on the engine's own needed-as-prereq tie-breaking, which the newly-real elective courses' own prereq graphs perturbed enough to silently break it (a real 'Could not schedule BBH 468' regression caught by re-running build_full_plan after this fix, not just spot-checking individual items).
